scenario.name: Launch announcement / APAC fintech
scenario.decision_question: Should we announce the new pricing in the launch post?

segments.name: Cost-sensitive SMEs
segments.summary: React strongly to per-seat pricing; adoption stalls when costs feel unpredictable.

source_excerpt.text: Segment A cares about cost; Segment B cares about reliability. The rollout targets APAC first.

segments.agent_quote: If the price climbs with every seat, we will stay on the spreadsheet another year.

segments.name: Reliability-first operators
segments.summary: Supportive when uptime evidence is shown first; sceptical of marketing claims.
segments.agent_quote: Show me the incident history and I will show you my migration plan.

segments.name: Platform builders
segments.summary: Early adopters; amplify API and webhook quality, drive supportive narratives.

source_excerpt.text: We will announce the new pricing on Monday.

segments.agent_quote: The new webhook semantics alone justify the upgrade for us.

segments.name: Regional partners
segments.summary: Wait for localised billing; uncertainty resolves late in the run.
segments.agent_quote: We will adopt when invoicing supports our tax regime.

segments.name: Finance reviewers
segments.summary: Small but influential; their objections cascade into SME and partner segments.

source_excerpt.text: We will announce the new pricing on Monday.

segments.agent_quote: Unbudgeted increases need a CFO memo, not a blog post.
